label: Equivalence
subgoals: Match each input stuck at the controlling value to the resulting output fault
Pair the input and output faults of an inverter with opposite values
Merge the local equivalences into classes with union-find

label: Dominance
subgoals: Show that every test for the input fault also detects the output fault
Drop the output fault at each multi-input gate's non-controlling response
Keep the dominated input faults as ATPG targets

label: Checkpoints and the collapse ratio
subgoals: Keep stem and branch faults in separate classes across fanout
Target primary inputs and fanout branches as checkpoints
Divide the collapsed count by the original count for the collapse ratio
